omega_projection.definition: Omega(state, dec) = (orbit_masks, p, F, r_count, hub_touch_count)
omega_projection.H_droppable_reason: every RR-admissible joint has weight <= 3, so dH = max(weight-3,0) = 0; H is invariant along every live path
omega_projection.p_note: p is equivalent to ORBIT_PHASE[p] since perm <-> (orbit,phase) is a bijection on the 720 permutations
omega_projection.omitted: hex_masks -- the 720-bit occupancy vector, the dominant part of exact state

abandonment_determinism.claim: Omega needs no nondeterminism for abandonment: given weight and new_orbit (both Omega-computable), the RR joint_kind table admits at most one abandonment value; any other value maps to 'other' -> outside_RR_joint_model -> DEAD
abandonment_determinism.soundness: assuming the unique RR-legal abandonment is a sound over-approximation: if the true hex_masks-determined value differs, the exact edge is DEAD and cannot reach Target A anyway

theorems.statement: Every exact RR-legal macro transition's Omega-image is an Omega-transition. Hence exact-reachable Target-A boundaries are a subset of Omega-reachable ones. If no Omega-path reaches Target A, no exact path does.
theorems.proof_sketch: exact legality is a conjunction; Omega retains every conjunct except the hex_masks no-repeat guard and relaxes the hex-dependent abandonment to its unique legal candidate, plus relaxes rotation-run length to all ell in 0..5; removing a conjunct only enlarges the relation. The Target-A predicate is computed identically since it reads only Omega-visible fields.
theorems.direction_warning: converse FAILS; an Omega-reachable Target-A boundary is NOT evidence of an exact one. Omega closes families, never witnesses them.

theorems.statement: Every macro edge, exact or Omega, increases popcount(orbit_masks) by exactly 1.
theorems.ground: extend guards the orbit_masks update by 'if move.weight >= 2', so weight-1 rotations leave it untouched; every joint sets om[q] |= 1<<phase; the assertion at extend lines 240-243 guarantees that bit was previously clear (implied by the visited check at line 221 plus the perm<->(orbit,phase) bijection). A macro edge is a rotation run plus exactly one joint.
theorems.corollary: hex_masks and orbit_masks are NOT redundant: hex_masks records every visited permutation, orbit_masks only the pass-start (joint-target) subset

theorems.statement: The Omega transition relation is acyclic; every Omega-path from Omega(A) has length at most 720 - popcount(orbit_masks(A)); branching is at most 6 rotation lengths x 4 admissible joint moves = 24. Hence Omega-closure is computable by a terminating memoized DFS.
theorems.answers_task_4: yes -- all legal exact transitions induce a finite, acyclic, depth-bounded transition relation on Omega

theorems.statement: H is invariant on live paths; any exact edge of weight >= 4 is both outside the RR model and permanently Target-A-fatal (H is add-only and Target A requires H == 0).

Quotienting Omega by the induced component partition (dropping orbit_masks) is UNSOUND: new_orbit = (om[q]==0) distinguishes 'orbit q unopened' from 'opened', but a partition in which q is a singleton component does not. Two states with identical partitions can admit different joint kinds (Z3 vs R), changing r_count and hence Target A.

tractability_caveat.note: nothing here bounds the reachable Omega image by a small number, and none was computed; claiming otherwise would repeat this project's history of over-scoped quotients

verdict: Soundness and termination are PROVED: Omega exists, contains only recognizer-read fields, is a sound one-sided simulation, and its transition relation is acyclic with depth <= 720 and branching <= 24. The reachable image was NOT computed and is not shown to be small. CLAUDE_OMEGA_FINITE_IMAGE_PROVED would be read as claiming a computed finite image and would overclaim; the accurate token is the soundness one, noting termination was also proved (strictly more than soundness alone).
